name: Ondo US Dollar Yield
oneLiner: USDY is Ondo's yield-bearing dollar token, backed by short-term U.S. Treasuries and bank demand deposits; non-U.S. investor permissioned.
collateral: Short-term U.S. Treasuries, iShares Short Treasury Bond ETF shares, and bank demand deposits
pegMechanism: Bank wire redemption at NAV-based price with independent verification and collateral agent oversight

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDY is a tokenized note issued under U.S. Securities Act Regulation S exemption, restricted to non-U.S. investors, and accrues yield via NAV appreciation rather than functioning as a fixed-value payment instrument. As of December 15, 2025, it is issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited, a BVI SPV. These characteristics place it outside the GENIUS Act's definition of a payment stablecoin.

genius.notes: USDY is structured as a tokenized note under Reg S, accessible only to qualifying non-U.S. investors, and accrues yield through NAV appreciation rather than functioning as a fixed-value payment stablecoin. As of December 15, 2025, Ondo USDY LLC was folded into the Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited umbrella as issuer. These structural and legal characteristics place it outside the GENIUS Act's payment stablecoin definition.

mintAuthority.summary: USDY issuance is Ondo-operated and remains economically unbounded overall. At Ethereum block 25711921, AccessControl enumeration identified four live MINTER_ROLE holders: the uncapped legacy USDYManager, a LayerZero adapter with replaceable per-EID inbound rate limits, a rate-limited USDY InstantManager, and a 4-of-7 Safe that can mint directly. The same Safe was the sole token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder, owned the token's ProxyAdmin, and could replace the adapter's peers and limits.

controls.label: Legacy USDYManager minter

routeChecks.signingModel: Subscriptions are administered through the 3-of-6 manager-admin Safe, while the separate 2-of-6 relayer/pricer Safe co-controls price-ID assignment and claim timing.
routeChecks.caps: No aggregate or immutable numeric issuance ceiling was identified in the verified USDYManager mint path.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: A claim requires a recorded subscription, an assigned price ID, and a claimable timestamp before USDYManager calls the token's mint function; those workflow checks do not impose an aggregate supply cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The 4-of-7 token-admin Safe and 3-of-6 manager-admin Safe hold manager administration roles; the 4-of-7 Safe can also revoke or replace this token MINTER_ROLE.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711921, token MINTER_ROLE enumeration still included this verified legacy USDYManager contract. Its verified claim path requires a deposited subscription, assigned price ID, and claimable timestamp before calling USDY mint, but applies no aggregate numeric ceiling. Ondo's address registry marks the manager deprecated; the live role and uncapped route are therefore preserved as direct authority.

controls.label: USDY LayerZero mint-burn adapter
controls.capDescription: Inbound bridge minting is limited per trusted LayerZero endpoint ID over rolling 24-hour windows: 500,000 USDY for EIDs 30110, 30181, and 30280; 300,000 USDY for EID 30168; and disabled for EIDs 30102 and 30370 at the observation block.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: LayerZero OApp peer checks bind inbound messages to owner-configured peers for EIDs 30102, 30110, 30168, 30181, 30280, and 30370 before crediting USDY.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: Message acceptance inherits the configured LayerZero EndpointV2 messaging and DVN verification path; this review does not restate a fixed DVN quorum because it is endpoint/path configuration.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The adapter checks and updates a per-EID inbound rate limiter before minting. Active 24-hour inbound limits were 500,000 USDY for EIDs 30110, 30181, and 30280 and 300,000 USDY for EID 30168; inbound mint was disabled for EIDs 30102 and 30370.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The 4-of-7 Ondo Safe owns the adapter and can change trusted peers and rate-limit parameters, so the observed limits are replaceable even though the adapter itself cannot raise them.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711915, the verified adapter was an active USDY MINTER_ROLE holder, owned by the 4-of-7 Ondo Safe, and configured with six LayerZero peers. Its inbound credit path authenticates the peer and applies the per-EID rate limiter before minting. The adapter is therefore cap-limited; its owner, not the adapter, can replace peers or raise limits.

controls.label: USDY manager-admin / admin-subscription Safe
controls.evidence: At blocks 25711917-25711921, this 3-of-6 Safe held USDYManager MANAGER_ADMIN and TIMESTAMP_SETTER_ROLE plus InstantManager ADMIN_SUBSCRIPTION_ROLE. It can authorize and time legacy-manager claims and use the separately capped admin-subscription path. Safe API reported no enabled modules and a zero guard.

controls.label: USDY relayer / pricer co-control Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711921, this 2-of-6 Safe held both RELAYER_ROLE and PRICE_ID_SETTER_ROLE on legacy USDYManager, co-controlling price-ID assignment and claim authorization without holding token MINTER_ROLE. Safe API reported no enabled modules and a zero guard.

controls.label: USDY InstantManager default-admin Safe
controls.evidence: At blocks 25711917-25711923, this 3-of-5 Safe was the sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder for InstantManager, AdminSubscriptionChecker, and OndoRateLimiter and also held their configuration roles. It can grant mint-route roles and directly raise or replace checker and limiter caps. Safe API reported no enabled modules and a zero guard.

controls.label: USDY rate-limit cap-admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711923, this 3-of-5 Safe held OndoRateLimiter CONFIGURER_ROLE and could raise the global or user subscription limits governing InstantManager minting. Safe API reported no enabled modules and a zero guard.

controls.label: USDY rate-limit operations Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711923, this 3-of-6 Safe held OndoRateLimiter CONFIGURER_ROLE and could raise the global or user subscription limits governing InstantManager minting. Safe API reported no enabled modules and a zero guard.

controls.label: USDY default admin / direct-minter Safe

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: As adapter owner, this Safe can replace the LayerZero peer accepted for each endpoint ID.
routeChecks.caps: As adapter owner, this Safe can raise or replace the per-EID bridge rate limits; as token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder, it can also replace MINTER_ROLE membership.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: This Safe is simultaneously a direct USDY minter, sole token default admin, adapter owner, and ProxyAdmin owner, so its direct token mint is an uncapped bypass of downstream route limits.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711921, this 4-of-7 Safe was one of four MINTER_ROLE holders and the sole token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder. It can mint directly, grant or revoke token roles, and as adapter owner raise bridge limits or replace peers. The Safe Transaction Service reported no enabled modules and a zero guard.

controls.label: USDY InstantManager minter
controls.capDescription: InstantManager issuance is bounded by the OndoRateLimiter's 100,000,000 USDY global subscription limit per 24 hours and 50,000,000 USDY default per-user subscription limit per 24 hours; the reviewed admin subscriber Safe additionally had about 9,081,309 USD of remaining configured allowance.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Public subscriptions require supported collateral transfer and the InstantManager's pricing, fee, and compliance checks before minting USDY.
routeChecks.rateLimits: OndoRateLimiter enforced a 100,000,000 USDY global subscription limit per 86,400 seconds and a 50,000,000 USDY default per-user subscription limit per 86,400 seconds.
routeChecks.caps: AdminSubscriptionChecker reported 9,081,308.999999999822580517 USD of remaining allowance for the 3-of-6 admin-subscription Safe at the observation block.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The 3-of-5 default-admin Safe can grant InstantManager and checker roles and configure their limits; separate 3-of-5 and 3-of-6 rate-limit configurer Safes can raise limiter caps.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711917, token MINTER_ROLE enumeration included this verified USDY InstantManager, whose public and admin subscription paths call the external limiter/checker before minting. At blocks 25711917-25711923, the active constraints were about $9.081 million of admin allowance, $100 million per 24 hours globally, and $50 million per 24 hours by default per user. The contract cannot raise those limits itself.

controls.label: USDY ProxyAdmin owner Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711753, ProxyAdmin owner() was this 4-of-7 Safe. The Safe can direct ProxyAdmin to replace USDY's implementation; no separate timelock, enabled Safe module, or nonzero guard was observed.

review.evidence: At Ethereum blocks 25711915-25711923, four live token MINTER_ROLE holders remained. Legacy USDYManager was an uncapped workflow-gated route; the LayerZero adapter was bounded by trusted peers and replaceable per-EID 24-hour limits; InstantManager was bounded by a roughly $9.081 million admin allowance plus $100 million global and $50 million default-user 24-hour limits; and the 4-of-7 Safe could mint directly. The reviewed Safes expose manager-admin, relayer/pricer, default-admin, cap-admin, direct-mint, and upgrade authorities, with no enabled modules or nonzero guards reported by Safe API. Overall semantics remain unbounded because the Safe direct-mint route and uncapped legacy path bypass downstream limits, while cap owners can replace limits. No public mint-authority incident was identified. Supervision remains attestation-only; reconciliation remains periodic based on Ondo's documented daily asset and investor-liability verification.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDY is natively issued by Ondo on Ethereum, Plume, Solana, Sui, Aptos, Stellar, and Noble. On Arbitrum, Mantle, and Sei the token is a LayerZero burn/mint representation minted by Ondo's own OApp (LayerZero EndpointV2-verified, Ondo Safe-owned; verified on-chain 2026-07-20). Cosmos deployments on Osmosis, Mantra, and Injective are IBC vouchers of Noble-native ausdy whose Noble-side ICS-20 escrows match voucher supplies exactly (verified 2026-07-20). DefiLlama also reports trace Penumbra and Glue labels (~$500 combined) that have no canonical chain mapping and remain an accepted bounded pool.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical USDY home deployment: the 4-of-7 Ondo Safe 0x1a694a09494e214a3be3652e4b343b7b81a73ad7 is the sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder and one of four MINTER_ROLE holders. OndoMintBurnAdapter 0xa6275720b3fb1efe3e6ef2b5bf2293148852307d also holds MINTER_ROLE, but its inbound LayerZero credit path authenticates owner-configured peers and applies replaceable per-EID 24-hour rate limits before minting; the 4-of-7 Safe can change those peers and limits.

Verified on-chain 2026-07-20: EIP-1967 proxy (impl 0x5692349f8e7081e2ad0ba629e01761b43187304c) with AccessControl DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE count 1 and MINTER_ROLE count 2. Admin = Ondo 4/7 Safe 0xc4ac5c2fa461901b4d91832d03a7018092edcb4d (Safe getThreshold=4, 7 owners). Minters = that Safe plus Ondo's LayerZero OApp 0x0be393dc46248e4285dc5caca3084bc7e9bfbb41, whose endpoint() returns LayerZero EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c and token() returns the USDY proxy; the OApp is owned by the same Safe. Cross-chain mint therefore requires LayerZero DVN verification plus Ondo Safe governance.
